title: ROS 2 topics
keywords: topic topics publish subscribe publisher subscriber message echo hz bw latched
text: Topics are named, typed, many-to-many publish/subscribe channels. A publisher and a subscriber connect only when the topic name, the message type and the QoS are compatible. Messages are not stored: a subscriber that starts later misses earlier messages unless both sides use transient-local durability, as latched topics such as /map and /robot_description do. ros2 topic echo, ros2 topic hz and ros2 topic info --verbose show the data, the rate and the QoS of every endpoint.
